name: Rice koji from steamed white rice
safety_targets: temp<=40C; high humidity then ventilation; final aw~0.80
notes: Temperature range combines BCCDC 27-40C koji control with 30C/80% RH/48h rice-koji preparation in Jung et al.; salt not applicable.

name: Barley koji
safety_targets: temp<=40C; high humidity then ventilation; final aw~0.80
notes: BCCDC states barley koji as koji grown on barley; ingredient mass is normalized single-substrate batch; no source dose for spores.

name: Short sweet white rice miso
notes: Kagawa sweet-miso formula: rice koji 17kg boiled soybeans 15kg seed water 2kg salt 2.0-2.4kg; source salt labels 5.5-6.6%.

name: Long red rice miso
notes: Kagawa spicy/red-style formula: rice koji 17kg boiled soybeans 30kg seed water 1kg salt 5.8-7.2kg; source salt labels 10.7-13.0%.

name: Traditional anchovy budu fish sauce
safety_targets: Codex fish sauce fermentation>=4320h; salt>=200g/L; pH 5.0-6.5 typical; histamine<=40mg/100g
notes: Budu source gives small marine fish mostly Stolephorus spp. mixed with salt 25-30% w/w for 12-18 months; converted as fish-mass salt because the method gives 1kg anchovy plus 25% sea salt; temperature recorded only as room temperature so temp fields left empty.

name: Rice-koji Pacific sand lance fish sauce
stages: koji pretreat 24-72 h at 20C; main fermentation 7200 h at 18C
notes: Salt range is converted from source additions of 10-20% salt by fish-paste mass plus 10% rice koji by fish-paste mass; total-batch salt is 8.3-15.4%.
